mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in workplace attendance indicates reduced daily commuting and associated spontaneous retail visits, leading to a further decrease in retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite continued decline in WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: If transit station activity continues its upward trend and crosses a critical threshold, it will signal increased public movement and confidence, driving retail and recreation mobility higher over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -25% from baseline, but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the subsequent two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of decreasing residential time and increasing grocery/pharmacy visits suggests people are out more for essential activities, which will spill over into increased retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, despite RESIDENTIAL decreasing and GROCERY_PHARM increasing.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of improving weather, a dip in retail and recreation mobility after a period of recovery suggests a temporary shift to outdoor activities, which will rebound into retail over the next week.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC dips after a recovery while PARKS remains strong
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next week, even if PARKS remains strong and RETAIL_REC had a recent dip.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent decline in residential mobility indicates fewer people staying home, freeing up time for out-of-home activities, which will lead to a gradual increase in retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, despite RESIDENTIAL continuing its decline.

mechanism_narrative: If workplace mobility continues its negative trend and drops below a critical threshold, it will signal a significant reduction in economic activity, further depressing retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES falls below -17% from baseline, but RETAIL_REC increases over the subsequent four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Despite increasing transit use, if workplace mobility continues to decline, it suggests transit is used for non-work purposes, which may not translate to increased retail activity, leading to a flat or slightly negative retail trend over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases significantly over the next two weeks, despite TRANSIT increasing and WORKPLACES decreasing.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of general mobility recovery, a simultaneous dip in both grocery/pharmacy and parks visits suggests a temporary lull in all out-of-home activities, which will likely lead to a dip in retail and recreation mobility over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both decline week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in the next week, despite GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both declining week-on-week.
